description: Search inventory items. `search` matches exact item codes and barcode labels first (e.g. "BM-002" printed on an asset tag), then names: word-prefix ("Lap" matches all laptops) plus an accent-insensitive substring pass ("stuhl" finds "Stühle" and "Bürostuhl"). The query is never shortened, so "Stühle" does not find "Bürostuhl": a shorter stem matches more. An empty result [] means no match. Filters, combinable with `search` and with each other: currentHolderId (a person resource id, or "me" for the connected user), categoryId, currentLocationId, status. categoryId and currentLocationId include the whole subtree by default (a top-level category returns its subcategories' items, a building its rooms' items); categoryMatch / currentLocationMatch "exact" limits the match to that node. Every non-draft item has a category; inventory_overview returns the category tree and list_resources the location and people trees whose node ids these filters take. No arguments lists the newest items. In results, `status` is the item's CONDITION (available = not defect/lost/retired), so an available item may still be borrowed (`currentHolder`). A row without `trackingMode` is one physical item; a "quantity" row is a stock pool whose count is `quantity`. `primaryCode` is the code printed on the asset tag, the one way to tell two identical models apart. `webUrl` / `listUrl` open the record and the filtered list in the web app. Rows carry no photo: get_item (one item) and show_items (a picker of several) return photos. Drafts (unreviewed captures, `isDraft`) are personal: results include only the connected user's own drafts, never another user's (admins included), not even by exact code or id.

categoryId.description: Filter by category id. Includes the whole subtree by default — see categoryMatch

categoryMatch.description: How categoryId matches. "subtree" (default) = that category AND all its subcategories, which is almost always what a person means. "exact" = only items filed directly on that category

currentHolderId.description: Filter by current holder: a person resource id, or the literal "me" for the connected user

currentLocationId.description: Filter by current location: a location resource id. Includes the whole subtree by default — see currentLocationMatch

currentLocationMatch.description: How currentLocationId matches. "subtree" (default) = that place AND everything inside it, so a building returns its rooms' items. "exact" = only items sitting on that place itself

search.description: Item code (exact match, e.g. BM-002) or name words (word-prefix plus accent-insensitive substring)

status.description: Filter by condition. "available" means not defect/lost/retired — the item may still be borrowed.

name: search_items

currencySums.description: Per-currency-field totals over EVERY matching row, not just this page — the answer to "what is this worth". Absent when the org has no currency field. A lower bound while `truncated` is true

label.description: Field label as the org named it

compartment.description: The compartment of that container the item sits in (absent = directly in the container)

container.description: The container this item is packed into, if any

effectiveHolder.description: Holder followed through the container chain

effectiveLocation.description: Location followed through the container chain

isDraft.description: Present and true only for an unfinished draft capture

modelId.description: The item's model — pass it as create_order lines[].modelId to order any instance of this model

primaryCode.description: The code printed on the item's asset tag — how a human tells two identical models apart. Absent when no code is attached

quantity.description: How many this row stands for — only on quantity-tracked pools. To count a pool, SUM this; to count serialized items, count rows

status.description: Condition: available | in_repair | defect | lost | retired ("available" means not defect/lost/retired — the item may still be borrowed)

trackingMode.description: "quantity" for a stock pool counted by amount. Absent = a serialized item, i.e. this row IS one physical thing

webUrl.description: Link to this item in the web app, for a person to open. Absent when the deployment has no public address configured

listUrl.description: Link that opens this same result in the web app. Absent when the filter combination has no list-URL form, or when the deployment has no public address

matchedBy.description: "code" when the query resolved as an exact asset code

note.description: Why an empty result is empty (e.g. no linked person for "me")

totalCount.description: Total matches (a lower bound when `truncated` is true)

truncated.description: The server scan hit its cap — narrow the search

title: Search items
